description: This Java class 'ScriptLinkHelper' provides utility methods for managing external script links in web pages, including caching inline scripts per user session, generating script URLs with CSRF tokens, and handling script inclusion at the end of HTML body for content security policy compliance.

classes.name: ScriptLinkHelper
classes.description: Final utility class for managing script links, caching inline scripts per session, and generating script URLs with CSRF tokens.

methods.name: addScriptLinkForBodyEnd
methods.description: Adds a script URL to the request attribute for inclusion at the end of the HTML body.

methods.name: getScriptLinksForBodyEnd
methods.description: Retrieves the set of script URLs to be included at the end of the HTML body.

methods.name: putScriptInCache
methods.description: Stores script content in a session-based cache with a unique key, handling cache size limits.

methods.name: getScriptFromCache
methods.description: Retrieves and removes a script from the session cache based on filename.

methods.name: cleanupScriptCache
methods.description: Removes all cached scripts for a given user session.

methods.name: prepareScriptLinkForBodyEnd
methods.description: Stores script content in cache, generates a URL with CSRF token, and adds it to the request for footer inclusion.
